hay_ant_hud: Roland "Ash" Hud left a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain behind in Rosenau and came up the line with a cracked shaving mirror. The men noticed at once that he talks to his rifle.
Roland "Ash" Hud was in the first hundred. The old hands in R-F10 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.
The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Roland "Ash" Hud looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A clear shot from R-F10. Roland "Ash" Hud badly wounded Nils Averelle and slid back down below the parapet.

A sniper's bullet hit Roland "Ash" Hud at R-F10. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Anselm "Parson" Rock of the Concord (@rotrek_rock). A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Roland "Ash" Hud was carried in at last. Roland "Ash" Hud opened his eyes today and asked for water. At R-F10 they cheered when the news came up the line.
local_distinguished_person: Oskar "Spark" Person reported to S-F16 with a bullet that missed him sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
The transfer made Oskar "Spark" Person a chaplain. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

Thunder all night. Oskar "Spark" Person kept flinching. The old hands said that is how you tell the new ones: they flinch at God. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Oskar "Spark" Person stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Oskar "Spark" Person traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.

Oskar "Spark" Person was peppered by shell splinters at S-F16. A medic picked them out one by one while the next salvo came in. A letter from home reached Oskar "Spark" Person before dusk. Oskar "Spark" Person read it twice and slept a little easier.
mvuisak: Pavel Mvuisak stepped off the supply cart at R-F17 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.

Bastian Xiii had Pavel Mvuisak of the Concord in his sights at Verdel Ridge for a long second. Pavel Mvuisak was lighting a pipe. Bastian Xiii let the match burn all the way down. Pavel Mvuisak walked the captured trenches of Verdel Ridge and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Rafael "Button" Superfeisty fixed the strap on Pavel Mvuisak's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
Pavel Mvuisak lost a boot to the mud at R-F17. It took two men and a rifle sling to get it back. The mud kept the sock.
